events: ending phase begins with the end step
cleanup completes or repeats under its exception rule
timing: the ending phase contains exactly the end step followed by the cleanup step
the next turn cannot begin before cleanup completes
an exceptional additional cleanup remains within the same ending phase
choices: choices created by end-step or cleanup rules are delegated to their owning step contracts
hidden_information: the phase transition itself reveals no hidden information
cleanup discard remains private under the cleanup-step contract
apnap: priority and trigger ordering within the component steps are delegated to the end-step and cleanup-step contracts
layers: turn-duration expiration is delegated to the cleanup-step contract
replacement_effects: replacement behavior inside either step is delegated to that step and the replacement-effect contracts
copy: copy status does not alter the two-step phase structure
control_change: control changes do not alter the two-step phase structure
zone_change: zone changes within the phase are handled by the component step contracts
source_leaves: source departure does not alter the two-step phase structure

variants: ordinary end step followed by ordinary cleanup
transition to the next player in a multiplayer turn order
